name: termcard
description: Look up terminal business cards (npx <name>) and get in touch with the people behind them.
long_description: termcard business cards are published on npm and opened with `npx <name>`. This extension lets Claude read any termcard card by its name — who someone is, what they do, how to reach them — save them as a contact (vCard) and draft an email you can review and send yourself. It is read-only: nothing is sent on your behalf, and cards are downloaded only from the npm registry and verified before use.

tools.name: get_card
tools.description: Get a person's termcard business card by its npm name.

tools.name: get_vcard
tools.description: Get the person's contact details as a vCard.

tools.name: compose_email
tools.description: Draft an email to the person as a mailto: link. Nothing is sent.
